sanskrit: pṛkṣasya vṛṣṇo aruṣasya nū sahaḥ pra nu vocaṁ vidathā jātavedasaḥ | vaiśvānarāya matir navyasī śuciḥ soma iva pavate cārur agnaye ||
english: Now will I proclaim the might of the vigorous, ruddy, bountiful one in the assembly — a fresh, pure thought for Vaiśvānara; as Soma streams purified, so it flows beautifully to Agni.

sanskrit: sa jāyamānaḥ parame vyomani vratāny agnir vratapā arakṣata | vy antarikṣam amimīta sukratur vaiśvānaro mahinā nākam aspṛśat ||
english: Being born in the highest heaven, Agni, the guardian of holy ordinances, watched over the cosmic laws. Of good understanding, Vaiśvānara measured out the mid-air and with his greatness touched the vault of heaven.

sanskrit: vy astabhnād rodasī mitro adbhuto 'ntarvāvad akṛṇoj jyotiṣā tamaḥ | vi carmaṇīva dhiṣaṇe avartayad vaiśvānaro viśvam adhatta vṛṣṇyam ||
english: The wondrous Mitra-like one propped apart the two world-halves; causing them to vibrate within, he expelled darkness with his light. He spread the two cosmic bowls apart as if they were skins; Vaiśvānara assumed universal virile power.

sanskrit: apām upasthe mahiṣā agṛbhṇata viśo rājānam upa tasthur ṛgmiyam | ā dūto agnim abharad vivasvato vaiśvānaram mātariśvā parāvataḥ ||
english: The great ones grasped him in the lap of the waters; the peoples stood around their praiseworthy king. Mātariśvan, as messenger of Vivasvat, brought Agni Vaiśvānara hither from the distant region.

sanskrit: yuge-yuge vidathyaṁ gṛṇadbhyo 'gne rayiṁ yaśasaṁ dhehi navyasīm | pavyeva rājann aghaśaṁsam ajara nīcā ni vṛśca vaninaṁ na tejasā ||
english: O Agni, age after age bestow ever-fresh, glorious wealth on those who praise thee in the assembly. Like a wheel's rim, O ageless king, cut down the sinner below as fire cuts down a tree with its blaze.

sanskrit: asmākam agne maghavantsu dhārayānāmi kṣatram ajaraṁ suvīryam | vayaṁ jayema śatinaṁ sahasriṇaṁ vaiśvānara vājam agne tavotibhiḥ ||
english: O Agni, maintain among our patrons the ageless, hero-rich sovereignty. May we, O Vaiśvānara, O Agni, win the prize of hundreds and thousands by thy aid.

sanskrit: adabdhebhis tava gopābhir iṣṭe 'smākam pāhi triṣadhastha sūrīn | rakṣā ca no daduṣāṁ śardho agne vaiśvānara pra ca tārīḥ stavānaḥ ||
english: With thy inviolable guardians, O thou worshipped one, protect our patrons, O thou who hast three stations. Guard us who have offered, and the company of givers, O Agni Vaiśvānara; carry them forward as thou art praised.

sanskrit: ahaś ca kṛṣṇam ahar arjunaṁ ca vi vartete rajasī vedyābhiḥ | vaiśvānaro jāyamāno na rājāvātiraJ jyotiṣāgnis tamāṁsi ||
english: The dark day and the bright day revolve in succession, perceived by all beings through the two realms of space. Agni Vaiśvānara, being born like a king, pierced through the darknesses with his light.

sanskrit: nāhaṁ tantuṁ na vi jānāmy otuṁ na yaṁ vayanti samare 'tamānāḥ | kasya svit putra iha vaktvāni paro vadāty avareṇa pitrā ||
english: I know not the warp, I know not the woof, nor what it is they weave in contest, those going to the conflict. Whose son is he here who shall speak what needs saying — one greater speaks with one who is lesser, his father.

sanskrit: sa it tantuṁ sa vi jānāty otuṁ sa vaktvāny ṛtuthā vadāti | ya īṁ ciketad amṛtasya gopā avaś caran paro anyena paśyan ||
english: He indeed knows the warp, he knows the woof; he speaks what needs saying in due season — he who perceived this, guardian of immortality, moving below yet seeing beyond with another.

sanskrit: ayaṁ hotā prathamaḥ paśyatemam idaṁ jyotir amṛtam martyeṣu | ayaṁ sa jajñe dhruva ā niṣatto 'martyas tanvā vardhamānaḥ ||
english: He is the first Hotṛ; behold this immortal light among mortals. He was born firm and settled here, the immortal one, waxing great in his own body.

sanskrit: dhruvaṁ jyotir nihitaṁ dṛśaye kam mano javiṣṭham patayatsv antaḥ | viśve devāḥ samanasaḥ saketā ekaṁ kratum abhi vi yanti sādhu ||
english: The fixed light is set on high for seeing; the mind, swiftest of things, flies within it. All the gods, of one mind and purpose, go forth rightly toward that single will.

sanskrit: vi me karṇā patayato vi cakṣur vīdaṁ jyotir hṛdaya āhitaṁ yat | vi me manaś carati dūrādhīḥ kiṁ svid vakṣyāmi kim u nū maniṣye ||
english: My ears fly open, my eye flies open; this light which was implanted in my heart blazes forth. My mind wanders far in thought — what shall I say? What shall I now contemplate?

sanskrit: viśve devā anamasyan bhiyānās tvām agne tamasi tasthivāṁsam | vaiśvānaro 'vatūtaye no 'martyo 'vatūtaye naḥ ||
english: All the gods bowed down in fear when thou, O Agni, didst stand in the darkness. May Vaiśvānara, the immortal, guard us; may he, the immortal, guard us.

sanskrit: puro vo mandraṁ divyaṁ suvṛktim prayati yajñe agnim adhvare dadhidhvam | pura ukthebhiḥ sa hi no vibhāvā svadhvarā karati jātavedāḥ ||
english: Set before you in the sacrifice, at the rite going forward, the gladsome, heavenly Agni of pure praise. First with hymns — for he, the far-shining Jātavedas, will make our sacrifices auspicious.

sanskrit: tam u dyumaḥ purvaṇīka hotar agne agnibhir manuṣa idhānaḥ | stomaṁ yam asmai mamateVa śūṣaṁ ghṛtaṁ na śuci matayaḥ pavante ||
english: O brilliantly faced Hotṛ, O Agni, kindled with fire among men, we honour him with the praise-song. The thoughts purified for him flow pure like clarified butter, like a shout of power as Mamatā would offer.

sanskrit: pīpāya sa śravasā martyeṣu yo agnaye dadāśa vipra ukthaiḥ | citrābhis tam ūtibhiś citraśocir vrajasya sātā gomato dadhāti ||
english: He has grown fat with fame among mortals, the wise man who has offered to Agni with hymns. The bright-flaming one bestows upon him wondrous aids for the winning of a cattle-pen.

sanskrit: ā yaḥ paprau jāyamāna urvī dūredṛśā bhāsā kṛṣṇādhvā | adha bahu cit tama ūrmyāyās tiraḥ śociṣā dadṛśe pāvakaḥ ||
english: He who on being born filled the two vast worlds with his far-seen radiance, making the dark path bright — even through the mighty surge of night's darkness the purifying one was seen by his flame.

sanskrit: nū naś citram puruvājābhir ūtī agne rayim maghavadbhyaś ca dhehi | ye rādhasā śravasā cāty anyān suvīryebhiś cābhi santi janān ||
english: Now, O Agni, with thy many-prize-bringing aids bestow wealth upon us and upon our patrons — those who surpass others in generosity and fame and in the power of heroes over men.

sanskrit: imaṁ yajñaṁ cano dhā agna uśan yaṁ ta āsāno juhute haviṣmān | bharadvājeṣu dadhiṣe suvṛktim avīr vājasya gadhyasya sātau ||
english: O Agni, rejoicing, give delight to this sacrifice which the seated oblation-offerer presents to thee. Among the Bharadvājas thou dost receive pure praise — grant the heroes their portion of vigorous sustenance.

sanskrit: vi dveṣāṁsī nuhi vardhayeḻām madema śatahimāḥ suvīrāḥ ||
english: Drive apart the two hatreds, increase Iḷā; may we rejoice for a hundred winters, rich in heroes.

sanskrit: yajasva hotar iṣito yajīyān agne bādho marutāṁ na prayukti | ā no mitrāvaruṇā nāsatyā dyāvā hotrāya pṛthivī vavṛtyāḥ ||
english: Sacrifice, O Hotṛ, urged and best fitted to sacrifice, O Agni; urge like the impulse of the Maruts. Turn hither Mitra-Varuṇa, the Nāsatyas, and Heaven and Earth for the hotraship.

sanskrit: tvaṁ hotā mandratamo no adhrug antar devo vidathā martyeṣu | pāvakayā juhvā vahniḥ āsā agne yajasva tanvaṁ tava svām ||
english: Thou art our most gladdening Hotṛ, not deceitful, a god within the assembly among mortals. With thy purifying tongue, O bearer Agni, sacrifice with thy own body.

sanskrit: dhanyā cid dhi tve dhiṣaṇā vaṣṭi pra devāñ janma gṛṇate yajadhyai | vepiṣṭho aṅgirasāṁ yad dha vipro madhu cchando bhanati rebha iṣṭau ||
english: For truly the most nourishing wisdom craves in thee to proclaim the birth of gods for him who praises to sacrifice. Most inspired of the Aṅgirases, when the wise singer at the rite chants the sweet meter.

sanskrit: adidyutat sv apāko vibhāvā agne yajasva rodasī urūcī | āyuṁ na yaṁ namasā rātahavyā añjanti suprayasam pañca janāḥ ||
english: Blazing brightly, O far-shining, fully pure Agni, sacrifice across the wide two worlds. Him whom the five peoples, having offered oblations with reverence, anoint as Āyu, easy to please.

sanskrit: vṛñje ha yan namasā barhir agnāv ayāmi srug ghṛtavatī suvṛktiḥ | amyakṣi sadma sadane pṛthivyā aśrāyi yajñaḥ sūrye na cakṣuḥ ||
english: I now strew the sacred grass with reverence for Agni; the ladle rich with ghee and pure praise is put in motion. The seat is established in the dwelling on earth; the sacrifice is set in place like an eye in the sun.

sanskrit: daśasyā naḥ purvaṇīka hotar devebhir agne agnibhir idhānaḥ | rāyaḥ sūno sahaso vāvasānā ati srasema vṛjanaṁ nāṁhaḥ ||
english: Favour us, O brilliantly faced Hotṛ, O Agni kindled with the divine fires. Grasping the wealth of riches, O son of strength, may we pass beyond the fence of sin.

sanskrit: madhye hotā duroṇe barhiṣo rāḷ agnis todasya rodasī yajadhyai | ayaṁ sa sūnuḥ sahasaḥ ṛtāvā dūrāt sūryo na śociṣā tatāna ||
english: In the midst of the dwelling, the ruling Hotṛ on the sacred grass, Agni, who pushes forward, is to be worshipped by the two worlds. He, the son of strength and guardian of cosmic order, has stretched his flame afar like the sun.

sanskrit: ā yasmin tve sv apāke yajatra yakṣad rājan sarvatāteva nu dyauḥ | triṣadhasthastataruṣo na jaṁho havyā maghāni mānuṣā yajadhyai ||
english: In thee, the fully pure, the adorable — sacrifice, O king; let Heaven now worship as if fulfilling completeness. Settled in three stations, swiftly like a runner's stride, sacrifice the human offerings and rich gifts.

sanskrit: tejiṣṭhā yasyāratir vaneRāṭ todo adhvan na vṛdhasāno adyaut | adrugho na dravitā cetati tmann amartyo 'vavatara oṣadhīṣu ||
english: He whose wheel blazes most sharply in the forest, who shines like one growing strong on the path striking forward — the non-deceiving, swift one is conscious in his very self, the immortal in the lowest plants.

sanskrit: sāsmākebhir etarī na śūṣair agniḥ ṣṭave dama ā jātavedāḥ | drvanno vanvan kratvā nārvoṣraḥ piteva jārayāyi yajñaiḥ ||
english: Thus with our powers like those of heroes, Agni Jātavedas is to be praised at home. Consuming the wooden fuel, conquering by wisdom, not a lazy bull — like a father he is to be won over by sacrifices.

sanskrit: adha smāsya panayanti bhāso vṛthā yat takṣad anuyāti pṛthvīm | sadyo yaḥ syandro viṣito dhavīyān ṛṇo na tāyur ati dhanvā rāṭ ||
english: His flames win admiration when he freely cleaves and courses along the broad earth. He who at once breaks loose, free-running, swifter than swift — like a debt-free wanderer he shines across the desert.

sanskrit: sa tvaṁ no arvan nidāyā viśvebhir agne agnibhir idhānaḥ | veṣi rāyo vi yāsi ducchunā madema śatahimāḥ suvīrāḥ ||
english: So thou, O Agni, kindled with all thy fires, come to our aid against him who oppresses us. Thou seekest riches and driv'st away misfortune; may we rejoice for a hundred winters, rich in heroes.

sanskrit: tvad viśvā subhaga saubhagāny agne vi yanti vanino na vayāḥ | śruṣṭī rayir vājo vṛtratūrye divo vṛṣṭir īḍyo rītiḥ apām ||
english: From thee, O blessed Agni, all blessings spread like the branches of trees. At thy swift call come riches, prizes, the conquest of adversaries, the rain of heaven, and the stream of waters worthy of praise.

sanskrit: tvam bhago na ā hi ratnam iṣe parijmeva kṣayasi dasmavarCāḥ | agne mitro na bṛhata ṛtasyāsi kṣattā vāmasya deva bhūreḥ ||
english: Like Bhaga thou dost bestow treasure for our desire; like one going everywhere thou dost rule with wondrous brightness. O Agni, thou art like Mitra of the great cosmic order, the distributor of abundant lovely wealth, O god.

sanskrit: sa satpatiḥ śavasā hanti vṛtram agne vipro vi paṇer bharti vājam | yaṁ tvam praceta ṛtajāta rāyā sajoṣā naptrā apāṁ hinoṣi ||
english: He, the true lord, slays Vṛtra with his might; O Agni, the wise one carries off the prize from the miser. He whom thou, O all-knowing one, born of cosmic order, dost spur with wealth, along with the son of the waters.

sanskrit: yas te sūno sahaso gīrbhir ukthair yajñair marto niśitiṁ vedyānaṭ | viśvaṁ sa deva prati vāram agne dhatte dhānyam patyate vasavyaiḥ ||
english: The mortal who has reached thy keen edge, O son of strength, through songs, hymns, and sacrifices — he, O god Agni, assumes all desirable things; he rules with riches.

sanskrit: tā nṛbhya ā sauśravasā suvīrā agne sūno sahasaḥ puṣyase dhāḥ | kṛṇoṣi yac chavasā bhūri paśvo vayo vṛkāyā raye jasuRaye ||
english: Those of wide renown and hero-rich — for heroes, O Agni, O son of strength, grant fulfilment. Thou dost make abundant cattle by thy might, and food — to the wolf, to the gracious one, to the niggard.

sanskrit: vadmā sūno sahaso no vihāyā agne tokaṁ tanayaṁ vāji no dāḥ | viśvābhir gīrbhir abhi pūrtim aśyām madema śatahimāḥ suvīrāḥ ||
english: O eloquent one, O son of strength, flying forth for us, O Agni, grant us offspring and progeny, and the prize for us. May we attain fulfilment with all our praises; may we rejoice for a hundred winters, rich in heroes.

sanskrit: agnā yo martyo duvo dhiyaṁ jujoṣa dhītibhiḥ | bhasan nu ṣa pra pūrvya iṣaṁ vurītāvase ||
english: The mortal who has cherished service to Agni with his devotions — truly that ancient one will choose refreshment for his protection.

sanskrit: agnir id dhi pracetā agnir vedhastamaḥ ṛṣiḥ | agniṁ hotāram īḻate yajñeṣu manuṣo viśaḥ ||
english: For Agni is the all-knowing, Agni is the most ordaining Ṛṣi. The peoples of Manu invoke Agni as Hotṛ in sacrifices.

sanskrit: nānā hy agne 'vase spardante rāyo aryaḥ | tūrvanto dasyum āyavo vrataiḥ sīkṣanto avratam ||
english: For men of different kinds strive for thy aid, O Agni, for wealth from the lord. The Āyus overcome the Dasyu with their observances, pressing upon the one who holds no vows.

sanskrit: agnir apsām ṛtīṣahaṁ vīraṁ dadāti satpatim | yasya trasanti śavasaḥ saṁcakṣi śatravo bhiyā ||
english: Agni gives the hero, the true lord, who overcomes in battle the waters, at whose strength the foes tremble with fear at the mere sight.

sanskrit: agnir hi vidmanā nido devo martam uruṣyati | sahāvā yasyāvṛto rayir vājeṣv avṛtaḥ ||
english: For Agni, the god knowing all, rescues the mortal from reproach. He is mighty; the wealth of him who holds Agni unchecked is unchecked in the prizes.

sanskrit: acchā no mitramaho deva devān agne vocaḥ sumatiṁ rodasyoḥ | vīhi svastiṁ sukṣitiṁ divo nṝn dviṣo aṁhāṁsi duritā tarema tā tarema tavāvasā tarema ||
english: O great friend of Mitra, O god Agni, speak to the gods for goodwill of the two worlds. Bring welfare and happy dwelling to men under heaven; may we cross over hostilities, sins, and ill ways — may we cross them, may we cross them with thy help.

sanskrit: imam ū ṣu vo atiThim uṣarbudhaṁ viśvāsāṁ viśām patim ṛñjase girā | vetīd divo januṣā kac cid ā śucir jyok cid atti garbho yad acyutam ||
english: Glorify with song this your guest who wakes at dawn, the lord of all peoples. He discerns heaven by birth; the pure one perpetually consumes, like an embryo, what is immovable.

sanskrit: mitraṁ na yaṁ sudhitam bhṛgavo dadhur vanapatāv īḍyam ūrdhvaśociṣam | sa tvaṁ suprīto vītahavye adbhuta praśastibhir mahayase dive-dive ||
english: Him whom the Bhṛgus well-placed, worthy of praise with his flame upward, set in the lord of the forest as Mitra — thou, O wondrous one, being well pleased with Vītahavya, dost magnify thyself day by day with praises.

sanskrit: sa tvaṁ dakṣasyāvṛko vṛdho bhūr aryaḥ parasyāntarasya taruṣaḥ | rāyaḥ sūno sahaso martyeṣv ā chardir yaccha vītahavyāya sapratho bharadvājāya saprataḥ ||
english: Be thou the uninjured increaser of strength, O lord, overcoming the uttermost of adversaries. O son of strength, extend wide shelter among mortals to Vītahavya and the wide-famed Bharadvāja.

sanskrit: dyutānaṁ vo atitiṁ svarṇaram agniṁ hotāram manuṣaḥ svadhvaram | vipraṁ na dyukṣavacasaṁ suvṛktibhir havyavāham aratiṁ devam ṛñjase ||
english: Glorify with pure praises your blazing guest, the heavenly man Agni, the Hotṛ of Manu, the one of auspicious rite — like an inspired singer of celestial speech, the god who carries oblations, the messenger.

sanskrit: pāvakayā yaś citayantyas kṛpā kṣāman ruruca uṣaso na bhānunā | tūrvan na yāmann etaśasya nū raṇa ā yo ghṛṇe na tatṛṣāṇo ajaraḥ ||
english: He who by the grace of his purifying, inspiring flame shone on the earth like the radiance of the dawn — pressing forward in the path of Etaśa at the battle, he who in the blaze is ageless and unsated.

sanskrit: agnim-agniṁ vaḥ samidhā duvasyata priyam-priyaṁ vo atitiṁ gṛṇīṣaṇi | upa vo gīrbhir amṛtaṁ vivāsata devo deveṣu vanate hi vāryaṁ devo deveṣu vanate hi no duvaḥ ||
english: Kindle fire upon fire for you with fuel, serve your dear and ever-dear guest. Seek ye with songs the immortal one; for the god among gods wins the desirable thing — the god among gods wins our service.

sanskrit: samiddham agniṁ samidhā girā gṛṇe śucim pāvakam puro adhvare dhruVam | vipraṁ hotāram puruvāram adruhaṁ kaviṁ sumnair īmahe jātavedaSam ||
english: With fuel and with song I praise the kindled Agni, the pure, the purifying, firm in front at the rite. The inspired Hotṛ, much-desired, not deceiving, the poet — we seek with goodwill Jātavedas.

sanskrit: tvāṁ dūtam agne amṛtaṁ yuge-yuge havyavāhaṁ dadhire pāyum īḍyam | devāsaś ca martāsaś ca jāgṛviṁ vibhuṁ viśpatiṁ namasā ni ṣedire ||
english: Thee, O immortal Agni, age after age they have established as their messenger, the bearer of oblations, the guardian worthy of praise. Gods and mortals alike, with reverence, have settled the ever-wakeful, omnipresent lord of the people.

sanskrit: vibhūṣann agna ubhayāṁ anu vratā dūto devānāṁ rajasī sam īyase | yat te dhītiṁ sumatiṁ āvṛṇīmahe 'dha smā nas trivarūthaḥ śivo bhava ||
english: Adorning thyself, O Agni, following the ordinances of both sides, thou travellest as the messenger of the gods through the two spaces. When we embrace thy thought and thy benevolence, then be thou our triple-sheltering, auspicious one.

sanskrit: taṁ supratīkaṁ sudṛśaṁ svañcam avidvāṁso viduṣṭaraṁ sapema | sa yakṣad viśvā vayunāni vidvān pra havyam agnir amṛteṣu vocat ||
english: We who know little would worship him of fair face, beautiful to see, well-formed, yet knowing more than the wise. Knowing all ordinances, may he sacrifice; may Agni carry forth the oblation and declare it among the immortals.

sanskrit: tam agne pāsy uta tam piparṣi yas ta ānaṭ kavaye śūra dhītim | yajñasya vā niśitiṁ voditiṁ vā tam it pṛṇakṣi śavasota rāyā ||
english: Him thou protectest and thou ferryest across, O Agni, who has reached out to thee, the inspired one, O hero, with his devotion — or the keen edge of the sacrifice, or the arousal — him thou fillest with strength and wealth.

sanskrit: tvam agne vanuṣyato ni pāhi tvam u naḥ sahasāvann avadyāt | saṁ tvā dhasvant vad abhy etu pāthaḥ saṁ rayiḥ spṛhayāyyaḥ sahasrī ||
english: Protect us, O Agni, from him who would injure us; protect us, O strong one, from blame. May the nourishing drink come to thee in full abundance; may the thousandfold, coveted wealth come to thee fully.

sanskrit: agnir hotā gṛhapatiḥ sa rājā viśvā veda janima jātavedāḥ | devānām uta yo martyānāṁ yajiṣṭhaḥ sa pra yajatām ṛtāvā ||
english: Agni is the Hotṛ, the householder, he is the king; Jātavedas knows all births. He who is most deserving of worship among gods and among mortals — may that guardian of cosmic order sacrifice for us.

sanskrit: agne yad adya viśo adhvarasya hotaḥ pāvakaśoce veṣ ṭvaṁ hi yajvā | ṛtā yajāsi mahinā vi yad bhūr havyā vaha yaviṣṭha yā te adya ||
english: O Agni, what thou dost today for the people in the rite — O Hotṛ of pure flame, for thou art the sacrificer — thou dost sacrifice by cosmic order in thy greatness, when thou existest widely. O youngest one, bear the oblations that are thine today.

sanskrit: abhi prayāṁsi sudhitāni hi khyo ni tvā dadhīta rodasī yajadhyai | avā no maghavan vājasātāv agne viśvāni duritā tarema tā tarema tavāvasā tarema ||
english: For the well-set offerings are to be seen; let the two worlds establish thee to sacrifice. Aid us, O generous one, in winning the prize, O Agni; may we cross over all misfortunes — may we cross them, may we cross them with thy help.

sanskrit: agne viśvebhiḥ svanīka devair ūrṇāvantaṁ prathamaḥ sīda yonim | kulāyinaṁ ghṛtavantaṁ savitre yajñaṁ naya yajamānāya sādhu ||
english: O Agni of fair countenance, with all the gods, sit first on the woolly seat. Lead the nest-like, ghee-filled sacrifice rightly to Savitr and the sacrificer.

sanskrit: imam u tyam atharvaVad agniṁ manthanti vedhasaḥ | yam aṅkūyantam ānayannamūraṁ śyāvyābhyaḥ ||
english: This is that Agni whom the inspired priests churn as Atharvan did — him whom they brought, eager and unwearied, from the dark cows.

sanskrit: janiṣvā devavītaye sarvatātā svastaye | ā devān vakṣy amṛtāṁ ṛtāvṛdho yajñaṁ deveṣu pispṛśaḥ ||
english: Be born for the gods' enjoyment, for complete welfare, for prosperity. Bring hither the immortal gods, the increasers of cosmic order; touch the sacrifice among the gods.

sanskrit: vayam u tvā gṛhapate janānām agne akarma samidhā bṛhantam | asthūri no gārhapatyāni santu tigmena nas tejasā saṁ śiśādhi ||
english: We have kindled thee great, O Agni, O householder of men, with fuel. May our domestic rites not be impeded; sharpen us with thy keen brilliance.

sanskrit: tvam agne yajñānāṁ hotā viśveṣāṁ hitaḥ | devebhir mānuṣe jane ||
english: Thou, O Agni, art the Hotṛ of all sacrifices, established by the gods among humankind.

sanskrit: sa no mandrābhir adhvare jihvābhir yajā mahaḥ | ā devān vakṣi yakṣi ca ||
english: Do thou at the rite worship the great ones with thy gladdening tongues; bring the gods hither and sacrifice.

sanskrit: vetthā hi vedho adhvanaḥ pathaś ca devāñjasā | agne yajñeṣu sukrato ||
english: For thou dost know the paths and the roads to the gods in their fullness, O Agni of good understanding at the sacrifices.

sanskrit: tvām īḻe adha dvitā bharato vājibhiḥ śunam | īje yajñeṣu yajñiyam ||
english: Bharata invoked thee then a second time with the swift ones for blessings; he worshipped the one worthy of worship at the sacrifices.

sanskrit: tvam imā vāryā puru divodāsāya sunvate | bharadvājāya dāśuṣe ||
english: Thou, the many desirable things, give to Divodāsa who presses the Soma, to Bharadvāja who presents the offering.

sanskrit: tvaṁ dūto amartya ā vahā daivyaṁ janam | śṛṇvan viprasya suṣṭutim ||
english: O immortal messenger, bring hither the divine folk, hearing the perfect praise of the inspired singer.

sanskrit: tvām agne svādhyo martāso devavītaye | yajñeṣu devam īḻate ||
english: Thee, O Agni, the mortals of devout mind invoke as the god at the sacrifices for the gods' enjoyment.

sanskrit: tava pra yakṣi saṁdṛśam uta kratuṁ sudānavaḥ | viśve juṣanta kāminaḥ ||
english: The bountiful ones set forth thy visible form and thy will; may all the desiring ones take delight in it.

sanskrit: tvaṁ hotā manurhito vahnir āsā viduṣṭaraḥ | agne yakṣi divo viśaḥ ||
english: Thou, the Hotṛ established by Manu, the bearer in thy mouth, who knowest most — O Agni, worship the peoples of heaven.

sanskrit: agna ā yāhi vītaye gṛṇāno havyadātaye | ni hotā satsi barhiṣi ||
english: O Agni, come hither, praised, for the feasting, for the gift of oblations; sit down as Hotṛ on the sacred grass.

sanskrit: taṁ tvā samidbhir aṅgiro ghṛtena vardhayāmasi | bṛhac chocā yaviṣṭhya ||
english: Thee, O Aṅgiras, we increase with fuel-sticks and with ghee; blaze mightily, O youngest one.

sanskrit: sa naḥ pṛthu śravāyyam acchā deva vivāsasi | bṛhad agne suvīryam ||
english: Thou, O god, winnest for us wide, praiseworthy, vast heroic glory, O Agni.

sanskrit: tvām agne puṣkarād adhy atharvā nir amanthata | mūrdhno viśvasya vāghataḥ ||
english: Thee, O Agni, Atharvan churned out from the lotus, from the head of every eulogist.

sanskrit: tam u tvā dadhyaṅṅ ṛṣiḥ putra īdhe atharvaṇaḥ | vṛtrahaṇam puraṁdaram ||
english: Thee, the Ṛṣi Dadhyaṅ, son of Atharvan, kindled — thee the slayer of Vṛtra, the breaker of strongholds.

sanskrit: tam u tvā pāthyo vṛṣā sam īdhe dasyuhantamam | dhanaṁjayaṁ raṇe-raṇe ||
english: Thee, the bull of the paths, the most destroyer of the Dasyu, the winner of spoils in battle after battle, Pāthya kindled.

sanskrit: ehy ū ṣu bravāṇi te 'gna ittheterā giraḥ | ebhir vardhāsa indubhiḥ ||
english: Come now; I would speak other words to thee, O Agni. With these drops of Soma grow great.

sanskrit: yatra kvac ca te mano dakṣaṁ dadhasa uttaram | tatrā sadaḥ kṛṇavase ||
english: Wherever thou dost place thy mind and the higher power, there thou makest thy seat.

sanskrit: nahi te pūrtam akṣipad bhuvan nemānāṁ vaso | athā duvo vanavase ||
english: No one has diminished thy abundance in the world of the half-circle dwellers, O lord. Yet thou dost win our service.

sanskrit: āgnir agāmi bhārato vṛtrahā purucetanaḥ | divodāsasya satpatiḥ ||
english: Agni of the Bharata clan has been approached — the slayer of Vṛtra, of wide perception, the true lord of Divodāsa.

sanskrit: sa hi viśvāti pārthivā rayiṁ dāśan mahitvanā | vanvann avāto astṛtaḥ ||
english: For he, seeking and unconquered, bestows with his greatness all earthly riches upon the worshippers.

sanskrit: sa pratnavan navīyasā agne dyumnena saṁyatā | bṛhat tatantha bhānunā ||
english: Thou, O Agni, like the ancient one yet made fresh, joined with new brilliance, hast spread out greatly with thy radiance.

sanskrit: pra vaḥ sakhāyo agnaye stomaṁ yajñaṁ ca dhṛṣṇuyā | arca gāya ca vedhase ||
english: O friends, present boldly to Agni your praise-hymn and your sacrifice; sing and chant to the ordaining one.

sanskrit: sa hi yo mānuṣā yugā sīdad dhotā kavikratuḥ | dūtaś ca havyavāhanaḥ ||
english: For he is the one who has sat for the ages of humanity as the poet-minded Hotṛ and messenger, the carrier of oblations.

sanskrit: tā rājānā śucivratā adityān mārutaṁ gaṇam | vaso yakṣīha rodasī ||
english: Those two kings of pure vows — the Ādityas, the troop of Maruts — O treasure-giver, worship them here along with the two worlds.

sanskrit: vasvī te agne saṁdṛṣṭir iṣayate martyāya | ūrjo napād amṛtasya ||
english: Good is thy sight, O Agni; it quickens the mortal — O offspring of vigour and immortality.

sanskrit: kratvā dā astu śreṣṭho 'dya tvā vanvan surekṇāḥ | marta ānāśa suvṛktim ||
english: Let the best by wisdom be given; today those who win thee with fair wealth — a mortal has attained pure praise.

sanskrit: te te agne tvotā iṣayanto viśvam āyuḥ | taranto aryo arātīr vanvanto aryo arātīḥ ||
english: Those aided by thee, O Agni, quickening to all life, crossing over the niggard's enmities, winning over the niggard's enmities.

sanskrit: agnis tigmena śociṣā yāsad viśvaṁ ny atriṇam | agnir no vanate rayim ||
english: May Agni go with his sharp flame against all devouring foes; may Agni win wealth for us.

sanskrit: suvīraṁ rayim ā bhara jātavedo vicarṣaṇe | jahi rakṣāṁsi sukrato ||
english: Bring us hero-rich wealth, O Jātavedas, O all-seeing one; slay the demons, O one of good understanding.

sanskrit: tvaṁ naḥ pāhy aṁhaso jātavedo aghāyataḥ | rakṣā ṇo brahmaṇas kave ||
english: Protect us from distress, O Jātavedas, from him who would harm us; guard our sacred prayers, O poet.

sanskrit: yo no agne dure vā ā marto vadhāya dāśati | tasmān naḥ pāhy aṁhasaḥ ||
english: The mortal who devotes himself to strike us from far or from near — protect us from that sin, O Agni.

sanskrit: tvaṁ taṁ deva jihvayā pari bādhasva duṣkṛtam | marto yo no jighāṁsati ||
english: Do thou, O god, drive off with thy tongue that evildoer — the mortal who seeks to kill us.

sanskrit: bharadvājāya saprataḥ śarma yaccha sahantya | agne vareṇyaṁ vasu ||
english: O wide-famed, mighty Agni, grant shelter to Bharadvāja, and desirable wealth.

sanskrit: agnir vṛtrāṇi jaṅghanad draviṇasyur vipanyayā | samiddhaḥ śukra āhutaḥ ||
english: May Agni, the seeker of wealth, smite the Vṛtras with marvellous might, kindled brightly, fed with oblations.

sanskrit: garbhe mātuḥ pituṣ pitā vididyutāno akṣare | sīdann ṛtasya yonim ā ||
english: The father in the womb of his own father and mother, flashing forth in the imperishable syllable, settling into the womb of cosmic order.

sanskrit: brahma prajāvad ā bhara jātavedo vicarṣaṇe | agne yad dīdayad divi ||
english: Bring us prayer rich in offspring, O Jātavedas, O all-seeing one — O Agni, that which shines in heaven.

sanskrit: upa tvā raṇvasaṁdṛśam prayasvantaḥ sahaskṛta | agne sasṛjmahe giraḥ ||
english: Towards thee, O glad one to behold, O one made strong, we who bring offerings have poured forth our songs, O Agni.

sanskrit: upa chāyām iva ghṛṇer aganma śarma te vayam | agne hiraṇyasaṁdṛśaḥ ||
english: As if to the shade of the sun's heat have we come for shelter to thee, O Agni of golden appearance.

sanskrit: ya ugra iva śaryahā tigmaśṛṅgo na vaṁsagaḥ | agne puro rurojitha ||
english: Thou who like a fierce archer, sharp-horned like a bamboo-cutter, hast broken open the strongholds, O Agni.

sanskrit: ā yaṁ haste na khādinaṁ śiśuṁ jātaṁ na bibhrati | viśām agniṁ svadhvaram ||
english: Him whom they bear as if a new-born child, a bracelet in the hand — the Agni of the peoples, the one of auspicious rite.

sanskrit: pra devaṁ devavītaye bharatā vasuvittamam | ā sve yonau ni ṣīdatu ||
english: Present the god, the best knower of goods, for the gods' enjoyment, O Bharatas; let him sit down in his own seat.

sanskrit: ā jātaṁ jātavedasi priyaṁ śiśītātiThim | syona ā gṛhapatim ||
english: Bring the beloved guest newly born into Jātavedas; let the gentle householder be brought near.

sanskrit: agne yukṣvā hi ye tavāśvāso deva sādhavaḥ | araṁ vahanti manyave ||
english: O Agni, yoke indeed those good horses of thine, O god, which bear sufficiently for zeal.

sanskrit: acchā no yāhy ā vahābhi prayāṁsi vītaye | ā devān somapītaye ||
english: Come hither to us, bring the gods hither to the offerings for the feasting, for the drinking of Soma.

sanskrit: ud agne bhārata dyumad ajastreṇa davidyutat | śocā vi bhāhy ajara ||
english: Blaze up, O Agni of the Bharatas, brilliantly, flashing forth unceasingly; shine widely and blaze, O ageless one.

sanskrit: vītī yo devam marto duvasyed agnim īḻītādhvare haviṣmān | hotāraṁ satyayajaṁ rodasyoḥ uttānahasto namasā vivāset ||
english: The mortal who would serve the god with the feast should praise Agni at the rite, the oblation-holder; he should worship with upraised hand and reverence the Hotṛ who truly sacrifices, of the two worlds.

sanskrit: ā te agna ṛcā havir hṛdā taṣṭam bharāmasi | te te bhavantu ukṣaṇa ṛṣabhāso vaśā uta ||
english: With sacred verse we bring thee the oblation fashioned by the heart, O Agni. May these be thine — the bulls, the oxen, and the cows.

sanskrit: agniṁ devāso agriyam indhate vṛtrahantamam | yenā vasūny ābhṛtā tṛḻhā rakṣāṁsi vājinā ||
english: The gods kindle Agni, the foremost, the most Vṛtra-slaying; by whom the goods are brought and the demons crushed, he the prize-winner.

sanskrit: pibā somam abhi yam ugra tarda ūrvaṁ gavyam mahi gṛṇāna indra | vi yo dhṛṣṇo vadhiṣo vajrahasta viśvā vṛtram amitriyā śavobhiḥ ||
english: Drink the Soma, O fierce and bold one, in relation to which thou hast pierced open the great cow-pen, O Indra, who art praised greatly. Thou who with brave arm, O bolt-handed one, hast slain all adversarial Vṛtra with thy powers.

sanskrit: sa īm pāhi ya ṛjīṣī tarutro yaḥ śipravān vṛṣabho yo matīnām | yo gotrabid vajrabhṛd yo hariṣṭhāḥ sa indra citrāṁ abhi tṛndhi vājān ||
english: Drink of the Soma, he who is pressed through the strainer, swift to cross over, he of the handsome cheeks, the bull of hymns, who breaks open the cow-stall, who bears the bolt, in whose team stand the bay steeds — that Indra, win the shining prizes.

sanskrit: evā pāhi pratnathā mandatu tvā śrudhi brahma vāvṛdhasvo ta gīrbhiḥ | āviḥ sūryaṁ kṛṇuhi pīpihīṣo jahi śatrūṁr abhi gā indra tṛndhi ||
english: So drink as of old; let it gladden thee; hear the sacred prayer, grow great with the songs. Make the sun manifest; refresh us, O thou who desirest to fill; slay the enemies, O Indra; win the cattle.

sanskrit: te tvā madā bṛhad indra svadhāva ime pītā ukṣayanta dyumantam | mahām anūnaṁ tavasaṁ vibhūtim matsarāso jarhṛṣanta prasāham ||
english: These thy exhilarations, O self-sufficient Indra, drunk and swelling, make thee brilliant. These intoxicating ones exulted in the great, sufficient, mighty, all-pervading, overpowering one.

sanskrit: yebhiḥ sūryam uṣasam mandasāno 'vāsayo 'pa dṛḻhāni dardrat | mahām adrim pari gā indra santaṁ nutthā acyutaṁ sadasas pari svāt ||
english: Gladdened, by which means thou didst set free the sun and the dawn, didst shatter the firm strongholds — the great mountain surrounding the cattle, O Indra, present — thou didst drive away the immovable from its own seat.

sanskrit: tava kratvā tava tad daṁsanābhir āmāsu pakvaṁ śacyā ni dīdhaḥ | aurṇor dura usriyābhyo vi dṛḻhod ūrvād gā asṛjo aṅgirasvān ||
english: By thy will, by those thy deeds of wonder, thou didst with thy power set the ripe within the raw. Thou didst open the firm doors for the Dawn-cows; O thou accompanied by the Aṅgirases, thou didst release the cattle from the enclosure.

sanskrit: paprātha kṣām mahi daṁso vy urvīm upa dyām ṛṣvo bṛhad indra stabhāyaḥ | adhāriyo rodasī devapuTre pratne mātarā yahvī ṛtasya ||
english: By great deeds thou hast spread the wide earth broadly; thou, lofty Indra, hast braced up the heavens. Thou hast upheld the two great, ancient, divine-born mother-worlds, the two ancient mothers, the mighty ones of cosmic order.

sanskrit: adha tvā viśve pura indra devā ekaṁ tavasaṁ dadhire bharāya | adevo yad abhy auhistha devān svarṣātā vṛṇata indram atra ||
english: Then all the gods before thee, O Indra, established thee alone, the mighty one, for the battle. When the godless one surged against the gods, they chose Indra here, in the winning of heaven.

sanskrit: adha dyauś cit te apa sā nu vajrād dvitānamad bhiyasā svasya manyoḥ | ahiṁ yad indro abhy ohasānaṁ ni cid viśvāyuḥ śayathe jaghāna ||
english: Then even Heaven trembled away from thy bolt in fear at thine own wrath. When Indra smote the serpent as it surged, the all-life-long one struck it down for it to lie.

sanskrit: adha tvaṣṭā te maha ugra vajraṁ sahasrabhṛṣṭiṁ vavṛtac chatāśrim | nikāmam aramaṇasaṁ yena navantam ahiṁ sam piṇag ṛjīṣin ||
english: Then Tvaṣṭṛ turned for thee, O great and fierce one, the bolt of a thousand points and a hundred angles. With it thou didst squeeze together the serpent, willingly restless and roaring, O thou of the Soma-strainer.

sanskrit: vardhān yaṁ viśve marutaḥ sajoṣāḥ pacac chatam mahiṣāṁ indra tubhyam | pūṣā viṣṇus trīṇi sarāṁsi dhāvan vṛtrahaṇam madiram aṁśum asmai ||
english: Him whom all the Maruts together strengthened, for whom a hundred buffaloes were cooked for thee, O Indra — Pūṣan and Viṣṇu, running the three streams, poured the Vṛtra-slaying, intoxicating Soma-shoot for him.

sanskrit: ā kṣodo mahi vṛtaṁ nadīnāṁ pariṣṭhitam asṛja ūrmim apām | tāsām anu pravata indra panthām prārdayo nīcīr apasaḥ samudram ||
english: Thou didst release the great flood, the mighty mass of the rivers hemmed in all around, the wave of the waters. Following their downward course, O Indra, thou didst set the downward-flowing waters flowing toward the ocean.

sanskrit: evā tā viśvā cakṛvāṁsam indram mahām ugram ajuryaṁ sahodām | suvīraṁ tvā svāyudhaṁ suvajram ā brahma navyam avase vavṛtyāt ||
english: Thus may the fresh sacred prayer turn towards us for protection, Indra who has done all these things — great, fierce, ageless, strength-giving, rich in heroes, well-armed, of good bolts.

sanskrit: sa no vājāya śravasa iṣe ca rāye dhehi dyumata indra viprān | bharadvāje nṛvata indra sūrīn divi ca smaidhi pārye na indra ||
english: Set us, O Indra, the inspired ones, toward the prize, toward fame, toward refreshment and wealth brilliant; O Indra, set the patrons rich in men among the Bharadvājas, and be renowned as in heaven, O Indra.

sanskrit: ayā vājaṁ devahitaṁ sanema madema śatahimāḥ suvīrāḥ ||
english: May we win by this means the prize set by the gods; may we rejoice for a hundred winters, rich in heroes.
